name: shopActions
author: Takaro
description: Built-in shop actions for common use cases like granting roles, sending messages, giving an Item Set, and executing commands. The give-item action gives an Item Set, managed on the server's Item Sets page. Upgrading from 0.0.1 unlinks every shop listing that uses one of these actions; re-link each listing to this version's action afterwards.

roleId.title: Role
roleId.description: The Takaro role to grant to the player.

broadcast.title: Broadcast
broadcast.description: If true, sends to all players. Otherwise, only to the buyer.

itemSet.title: Bonus item set
itemSet.description: The item set the buyer receives as a bonus on purchase.

command.title: Command
command.description: The console command to execute on the game server.

grantRole.description: Grants a Takaro role to the player who made the purchase.

sendMessage.description: Sends an in-game message to the buyer or broadcasts to all players.

giveItem.description: Gives an Item Set as a bonus to the player who made the purchase.

executeCommand.description: Executes a console command on the game server.
